- Maya is waiting on the exact number of Orbitly events dropped since #240 for Thursday's call with Orbitly — you have it (~1.18M, ≈8.1% of their iOS volume, plus 3,812 for Zest). Reply to her on #247. [1][2]

- Maya reviewed #247; she'll approve once CI is green but wants the drop count first. [2]

## What you did

- Verified Zest is marginally affected too, and that replaying from landing will restore the lost events once #247 is deployed. [1]
